hero.title: Find & Delete Your Ghost Accounts
hero.subtitle: The average person has 168 online accounts but remembers only 20–30. GhostAccounts scans your inbox, shows you what's hiding in the shadows, and helps you delete what you don't need.

problem.title: Your Forgotten Accounts Are a Ticking Time Bomb
problem.risk1_desc: Old accounts with weak passwords and no 2FA are prime targets for hackers and credential stuffing attacks.
problem.risk2_desc: Companies continue to collect and sell data from inactive accounts — without your knowledge.
problem.risk3_desc: Forgotten subscriptions quietly charge you. The average person loses €62/year to subscription creep.
problem.risk4_desc: Breach monitors only show the damage after it's done. No tool finds ALL your accounts proactively.

features.title: Everything You Need to Reclaim Your Privacy
features.subtitle: GhostAccounts is the only tool that finds ALL your accounts — not just the ones already in data breaches.
features.scan_desc: We scan your inbox for registration emails directly in your browser. No email content ever leaves your device.
features.list_desc: See every service you've ever registered with, when you last used it, and whether it's been breached.
features.score_desc: A clear 0–100 risk score based on account inactivity, breach status, and overall exposure.
features.delete_desc: One-click access to the deletion page for every service, with step-by-step guidance and difficulty rating.
features.monitor_desc: Get notified immediately when any of your found accounts appears in a new data breach. (Pro)
features.privacy_desc: GDPR-compliant by design. Only service names are stored — never email content or personal data.
